current_h31aa_run.hypothesis: H31-AA (SLFS): Unmapped Great Basin range-bounding and degraded pre-Holocene piedmont faults exhibit a strike-persistent concave-up break in LOGARITHMIC slope -grad(ln(s + 1.5 deg)).u_down across 2-11 deg piedmont-to-lower-front transitions (tapering to zero above 18 deg intra-range cliffs), distinguishable from horizontal Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut benches via along-strike elevation variation and subsurface gravity / depth-to-basement / magnetic-contact steps, and localizable on strict 1-pixel cross-strike directional crests without any catalogue label input.
current_h31aa_run.mechanism: AA2 (AA2_crest): LFLEX_SHORE (steered log-flexure x paleoshoreline null 1-px crest); scales sigma in {1.5, 3.0} px, strike steering +-4 px, shoreline survival weight w_shore in [0.35, 1.0], 1-px cross-strike crest, Poisson 2.8 px emission, 37654 binary dots on d(catalogue) > 2 px.
current_h31aa_run.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan / pluvial equipotential wave-cut shorelines (damped by low along-strike delta-z + weak subsurface step), intra-range bedrock cliff/talus breaks >18 deg (zeroed by piedmont habitat window), V-valley canyon mouths (suppressed by +-400 m contour-strike steering), alluvial fan terrace risers, and volcanic flow toes.

scientific_method_audit.implementation: Binary dilation of the public catalogue mask by six pixels, removal of the catalogue core, one erosion, then an offset 7x7 grid. The source does not test for two fault strands or construct a stepover-specific structural feature.
scientific_method_audit.qualification: The archived H-STEO name/mechanism overstate the implementation: it is a sparse mask around known catalogue faults, not an independently observed stepover detector.

holdout_dti.reason: The existing H-STEO is a catalogue-mask geometry, not a trained geological feature model; private truth was not available, the feature stack was not restored, and no method paragraph assigned a lane.

single_feature_leakage_canary.reason: No feature stack was restored and no model was fitted in this read-only audit.
